lede: The biggest thing on the table this week is San Miguel County's Tuesday hearing on a sweeping set of Land Use Code amendments that would add an entirely new Natural Resources article — with separate public hearings on forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal operations. Alongside that, Telluride's HARC takes up the large-scale Shandoka Lot redevelopment on Black Bear Road, and the School Board revisits the mill levy override discussion that's been threading through meetings all fall. Norwood's Planning and Zoning is also working through Land Use Code and Master Plan updates that will shape that town for years.

notable.stake: Land Use Code and Master Plan updates set Norwood's growth rules for years ahead.
